description: Start (or refresh) an analytics scan of an account. Runs in the background and shows in INSSIST's Insights dashboard; poll insights_report for progress and results. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

followers.description: Also scan followers for audience stats. Slower.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

postsLimit.description: Max posts to scan, 1-1500. Omit for the default.

name: insights_collect
title: Insights collect
